submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate ONE independent full-body character animation frame: 02_fire_talisman_boy / cast / W / 09, spell-release peak facing SCREEN LEFT. Single native square RGBA frame at least 1024; intended export is 1024x1024. Not a sprite sheet.
References: Image 1 is authoritative identity: chestnut high ponytail, red-jewel gold crown, warm amber eyes, short ornate red-gold Taoist robe with flame hems, black pants, red-black-gold shoes, yin-yang waist medallion. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds exactly FIVE separate RED rectangular talisman cards with golden flame motifs in a spread fan; anatomical LEFT hand grips one bronze ritual bell with red tassel. Image 2 gives the W left-facing profile and view of the opposite side of the costume. Image 3 is the main approved rounded, bright clean hand-painted Taoist chibi art style; ignore UI and scenery. Image 4 is the release key drawn for E, supplied for identity/pose stage/materials only: independently reconstruct this new W view, NEVER mirror or copy its pixels. Image 5 gives approximate correct character size and the 90%-height invisible ground on the square canvas.
W camera and anatomy are critical: character face looks strictly SCREEN LEFT; the anatomical LEFT shoulder/arm is camera-NEAR and must hold the BRONZE BELL. The anatomical RIGHT shoulder/arm is camera-FAR and must hold the FIVE-CARD FAN. Do not swap prop hands just because direction changes. The near left arm bends upward and back to hold the bell visibly near the left shoulder at screen-right; its hand wraps naturally around the bell handle, wrist connected to sleeve. The far right arm extends FORWARD toward screen-left and a little upward, projecting out from far shoulder past the torso; the fan and the visible palm emerge clearly to screen-left, all FIVE distinct card faces and grasped bases readable. Far arm root may be occluded by chest but it must be anatomically connected. Give the two hands/props separate silhouettes.
Pose: strong clear casting release. Short chibi torso leans slightly toward screen-left, face focused with slightly open mouth. Stable modest staggered feet, front foot toward screen-left planted with bent knee, rear foot toward screen-right supporting push-off; both legs, ankles and shoes distinct. Small natural twist shows the new W near side rather than mirrored E drawing. No released cards, both physical props remain held. Ponytail/ribbon, red tassel and robe hem follow body motion.
Registration: FIXED square canvas camera and character scale, entire character full body. Place virtual root at horizontal 50%, invisible ground at vertical 90%; leave transparent EMPTY bottom margin 10% under shoe soles. Normal upright full crown-and-ponytail silhouette occupies about 76% of canvas height, highest hair point around14%; this bent release may lower the head naturally but do not zoom or resize head/body to fill the canvas. Match face/head pixel size of the same sequence reference. All parts at consistent scale, no bbox auto-fit. At 1024 export ground is y920/root x512.
Render: preserve approved rounded, dimensional fine hand-painting, broad readable forms, gentle warm shading, crisp silhouette and restrained gold detail, no plastic gloss. Large head and short arms/legs.
True transparent alpha background. No backdrop, ground line, shadow, checkerboard, text, labels, detached particles, aura, glow, fire, projectile, motion trail or duplicate anatomy.
